P.name: Sovereign's Domination
P.title: Template:Data Viego/Sovereign's Domination
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Sovereign's Domination|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Viego
|skill        = I
|icon         = Sovereign's Domination.png
|blurbicon = Sovereign's Domination.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} will spawn a ''Mist Wraith'' for a period. {{ci|Viego}} can consume the ''Mist Wraith'' to briefly become {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|blink}} to it, which {{tip|heals}} him for a portion of the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}} and grants ''Possession''.
|blurb2      = Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or consuming a ''Mist Wraith'' will end ''Possession'' early.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|Possession:}} For a period, '''Viego's''' items, stats, basic attacks, and basic abilities become those of the slain enemy's. He also gains a free cast of ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing an enemy champion.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Viego''' scores an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, a ''Mist Wraith'' spawns from that champion's corpse for 8 seconds. '''Viego''' can basic attack a ''Mist Wraith'' to consume it: causing him to {{tip|blink}} to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is {{tip|untargetable}} (except to {{tip|turrets}}) and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. He then gains ''Possession'' and {{tip|heals}} himself for {{as|2%|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
|icon2 = Sovereign's Domination 2.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Possession:}} For 10 seconds, '''Viego''' assumes the enemy champion's form and gains their {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}}, [[item]]s (excluding [[trinket item]]s), and base [[champion statistic|stats]] (based on '''Viego's''' [[Experience (champion)|level]]). He also gains a free cast of ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'', which is initially placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown, and {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing enemy champions within 2500 units.
|description3 = '''Viego''' cannot use the possessed champion's [[Active ability items|item actives]] or [[consumable item]]s, and is unable to use the [[shop]] during ''Possession''. Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' ends ''Possession'' immediately.
|description4 = '''''Viego''' will preserve his {{as|'''current''' health percentage}} between transformations.''

|notes        = 
* '''Viego''' will copy the possessed champion's ability ranks.
** '''Viego''' cannot level up their abilities with his available skill points.
* ''Mist Wraiths'' will expire when '''Viego''' dies, and they will not expire while he is winding up on them.
* '''Viego''' gains the bonus movement speed during possession even while moving towards nearby enemy champions that are {{tip|untargetable}}.
* Finishing the possessing attack against a ''Mist Wraith'' kills it, rewarding '''Viego''' an extra {{g|3}} as he becomes the target champion.
* The wind up's {{tip|untargetability}} does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}} from {{tip|turret|turrets}}.
* The possessed champion's abilities do not cost any {{tip|mana}} or {{tip|energy}} even if that specific champion normally uses either as a [[casting resource]].
** [[Manaless#Alternative_gating_mechanics|Alternative resources]], such as {{tip|Fury}}, {{tip|Flow}}, or {{tip|Health resource|Health}}, will still be utilized.
** When possessing {{ci|Akali}}, '''Viego''' is given 10,000 energy. This causes his secondary resource bar to render incorrectly.{{bug}}
* The current cooldowns of '''Viego's''' abilities will '''not''' be reset between transformations.
** Those of the possessed champion's abilities will be reset between transformations.
** This does not apply to the following long-cooldown abilities. '''Viego''' specifically tracks their proper cooldowns which can be seen via a buff in his hotbar for each when applicable.
*** {{cai|Rebirth|Anivia}}
*** {{cai|Cell Division|Zac}}
*** '''Viego''' will not track {{cais|Cultivation of War|Zaahen}} cooldown.{{bug}}
* The passive cooldowns of items are shared between '''Viego's''' and the possessed champion's.
** This does not apply to {{nie|Lifeline}} items.{{bug|2}}
* Once ''possession'' ends, '''Viego''' returns to his normal state and certain effects gained from the possessed champion's abilities will be immediately removed.
** Some buffs will be kept and some buffs will be lost.
*** '''Viego''' will almost always keep {{tip|shield|shields}} and {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}}.
*** [[Passive]] effects will be lost by default, as '''Viego''' no longer has their abilities.
** {{tip|Channel|Channeled and charged abilities}} maintained will be interrupted, and without granting any cancelation refunds to the respective slot (if applicable).
** [[Champion ability|Toggled abilities]] will be automatically toggled off.
* When taking ''possession'' of {{ci|Kled}}, '''Viego's''' {{as|'''current''' health percentage}} will become '''Kled's''' {{as|health percentage}}, while '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|health percentage}} will be the same as when he {{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|remounts}}.
** Once ''possession'' ends, '''Viego''' only keeps {{cis|Kled}} {{as|health percentage}} as his current.
* '''Viego''' retains his own [[summoner spell]]s, [[trinket item]], and [[rune]]s during ''possession''.
* ''Mist Wraiths'' will still spawn while '''Viego''' is in a zombie state.
* ''Sovereign's Domination'' will not summon a ''Mist Wraith'' from {{tip|clone|clones}}.
* The ''possession'' will not expire while '''Viego''' is in a {{tip|zombie state}}.
** While in a zombie state, ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' is disabled.
** If '''Viego''' enters a zombie state while winding up on a ''Mist Wraith'', the possession will still last its normal duration.{{bug|2}}
* The ''possession'' will not end prematurely if '''Viego''' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
**  The ''possession'' '''will''' end if it expires while '''Viego''' is under {{cais|Cultivation of War|Zaahen}} {{tip|resurrection}}; he will lose all its effects instantly and be revived without restoring the complete amount of health.{{bug}}
* The ''possession'' will acquire the basic abilities of shapeshifting champions (e.g. {{cai|Spider Form / Human Form|Elise}}, {{cai|Transform Mercury Cannon|Jayce}} / {{ai|Transform Mercury Hammer|Jayce}}, and {{cai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}) based on which form they died as.
* ''Mist Wraiths'' are considered {{tip|minion|minions}} and can only be targeted by '''Viego'''.
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy champion who owns {{ii|Dark Seal}} or {{ii|Mejai's Soulstealer}}, he will gain their {{nie|Glory}} stacks during the possession.
* As {{ii|Cull}} tracks its progress for each player even if they do not possess the item at the time, '''Viego''' may discharge stacks for the benefit of {{g|1}} each per {{tip|minion}} kill, and if '''Viego''' killed 100 minions possessing {{ii|Cull}}, no matter whether bought himself or acquired via a possessed champion's inventory, he receives the {{g|350}} payout and can no longer discharge stacks. 
** This entire interaction does not interact with the state of the {{ii|Cull}} stacks of the enemy.
** The stacks shown on the item in the inventory and scoreboard may not update properly, however.
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy champion who owns {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}}, the stacks it has will be transferred to his {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}} if he owns one.
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy {{ci|Bel'Veth}}, his attack speed cap will be modified to 90 permanently.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Viego''' posesses an enemy {{ci|Evelynn}}, he will never activate the healing from {{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}.{{bug}}
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy {{csl|Evelynn|KDA}}, he will still hear {{ais|Demon Shade|Evelynn}} music upon discarding the possession if he does it while active.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Viego''' targets a ''Mist Wraith'' while already {{tip|untargetable}} he will become targetable once again during the cast time.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy on {{tip|Howling Abyss}}, he will be able to use the [[shop]] upon returning to the [[fountain]] and discarding the possession.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Viego''' posesses an enemy {{ci|Naafiri}}, he will keep her {{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}} upon discarding the possession.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy {{ci|Fiora}} and the possession expires while performing {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}, {{ai|Spectral Maw|Viego}} will be placed on ''Riposte's'' cooldown.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Viego''' possesses an enemy {{ci|Rek'Sai}}, ''Tunnels'' he creates will persist after discarding the possession. These ''Tunnels'' cannot be destroyed by standing on their entrance, and do not expire as time passes. {{bug|1}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Viego''' is winding up on a ''Mist Wraith'':
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death}}
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Viego_Original_KillFirst_3.ogg}} ''"You will serve!"''
}}

Q.wikitext:
<!-- The following values are defined as parameters.
-->{{#vardefine:q_p1|2}}<!-- PASSIVE rank 1 on-hit target current health ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_p5|6}}<!-- PASSIVE rank 5 on-hit target current health ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_p1_min|10}}<!-- PASSIVE rank 1 minimum on-hit damage
-->{{#vardefine:q_p5_min|30}}<!-- PASSIVE rank 5 minimum on-hit damage
-->{{#vardefine:q_p_mcap|80}}<!-- PASSIVE on-hit damage cap vs monsters
-->{{#vardefine:q_mark_t|4}}<!-- PASSIVE MARK duration in seconds
-->{{#vardefine:q_mark_ad|20}}<!-- PASSIVE MARK consumption AD ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_mark_ap|15}}<!-- PASSIVE MARK consumption AP ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_mark_cheal|150}}<!-- PASSIVE MARK consumption heal mod vs champion as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_mark_miheal|100}}<!-- PASSIVE MARK consumption heal mod vs minion as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_mark_moheal|125}}<!-- PASSIVE MARK consumtpion heal mod vs monster as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_a1|25}}<!-- ACTIVE rank 1 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:q_a5|85}}<!-- ACTIVE rank 5 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:q_aad|70}}<!-- ACTIVE AD ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:q_act_mod|1.4}}<!-- ACTIVE cast time, ratio of windup time as a DECIMAL
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Blade of the Ruined King|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Viego
|skill        = Q
|icon         = false
|blurbicon = Blade of the Ruined King.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Viego}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''current''' health}}. Additionally, '''Viego's''' damaging abilities apply a mark to enemies hit. His next basic attack will consume the mark to strike twice, dealing additional {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|healing}} him.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' stabs in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased based on his {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}.
|blurb4       = ''Blade of the Ruined King's'' passive remains under ''{{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}}''.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Viego's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|170|50}}|critical damage}} damage, has a minimum threshold and is capped at {{#var:q_p_mcap}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:q_p1}} to {{#var:q_p5}}}}% of target's '''current''' health}}|Critical Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:q_p1}}*1.7 to {{#var:q_p5}}*1.7}}% of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|{{#var:q_p1_min}} to {{#var:q_p5_min}}}}}}
|description2 = Additionally, his damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for {{#var:q_mark_t}} seconds. '''Viego's''' next basic attack against a marked target is empowered to consume the mark {{tip|on-hit}} to strike a second time, dealing {{tt|{{as|{{#var:q_mark_ad}}% AD}} {{as|(+ {{#var:q_mark_ap}}% AP)}}|Scales on current AD and AP}} {{as|physical damage}}. He also {{tip|heal|heals}} himself for a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by the second strike: {{#var:q_mark_miheal}}% against {{tip|minions}}, {{#var:q_mark_moheal}}% against monsters, and {{#var:q_mark_cheal}}% against other targets.
|description3 = The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Viego|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
|icon4        = Blade of the Ruined King.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' stabs in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 60|critScaling=true}}.
|leveling4    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:q_a1}} to {{#var:q_a5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:q_aad}}% AD)}}}}
|description5 = ''Blade of the Ruined King's passive remains under {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}}, and while transformed, the second strike is instead converted to '''bonus''' damage on-hit which no longer applies on-hit effects but can still {{tip|critically strike}} (based on the Possession's stats, abilities and/or item effects).''
|cooldown     = {{ap|5 to 3}}
|range        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|-25 - 600|Rectangle length is 625 units total, starting from 25 units behind Viego's center}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|125|Rectangle full width}}
|angle        = 
|cast time    = {{as|{{ap|{{#var:q_act_mod}}*100}}% of '''Viego's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|{{#var:q_act_mod}}*(1/{{ccd|Viego|as_base}})*{{ccd|Viego|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})
|speed        = 
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = special
|parry        = special
|projectile   = false
|callforhelp  = 
|notes        = 
* ''Blade of the Ruined King'' deals:
** {{Tip|Area damage}} for the thrust.
** {{Tip|Basic damage}} for the second strike.
** {{Tip|Proc damage}} for the on-hit bonus damage.
* Ability damage that applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects (''e.g.'', {{ais|R|Viego}} damage against the primary target) cannot apply the mark but can consume it, as a basic attack would.
* The second strike rolls {{tip|critical strikes}} independently from the primary attack.
* This ability's cast time respects the attack speed [[Attack speed|floor and cap]].
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* '''Viego''' will not perform the second strike if the first attack was {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked|blocked}}, and {{tip|blind|missed}}.
* If the second strike hits a dead unit, '''Viego''' will still {{tip|heal}} based on the post-mitigation damage that he would deal with it.
* The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.
* The mark does not cause '''Viego''' to attack twice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Blade of the Ruined King''. (e.g. {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
|tips         = 
* ''Blade of the Ruined King's'' cast time at a given basic attack timer can be calculated as: [{{#expr:{{#var:q_act_mod}}*(0.3+{{ccd|Viego|attack_delay_offset}})round3}} ÷ {{as|'''total''' attack speed|attack speed}}] (in seconds).
** The cast time equals {{rutngt|0.25}} (which is the standard for most abilities in ''League of Legends'') at approximately {{as|{{fd|32.6}}% '''bonus''' attack speed|attack speed}} (as of [[V25.07]]).
}}

E.name: Harrowed Path
E.title: Template:Data Viego/Harrowed Path
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Harrowed Path|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Viego
|skill        = E
|icon         = Harrowed Path.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Viego}} sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake for a period. If it hits [[terrain]], the mist is spread further around either side. 
|blurb2      = While inside the mist, '''Viego''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|camouflage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. If it hits [[terrain]], the mist will spread further around either side.
|description2 = While inside the mist, '''Viego''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|camouflage}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Harrowed Path 2.png
|description3 = Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, preventing '''Viego''' from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large {{tip|monster}}. This duration refreshes on subsequent attacks and ability casts.
|description4 = ''Harrowed Path can be cast during any of '''Viego's''' abilities. '''Viego''' cannot gain the camouflage nor {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from Harrowed Path for 1 second if he casts it during {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} channel or starts the channel while the mist was active.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|14 to 6}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 
|costtype     = 
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|customlabel  = Detection Radius
|custominfo   = 450
|range        = {{dv|{{tt|775|Initial missile reach for collision with a wall}}|{{tt|8000|Maximum distance of the mist spreading along a very long wall}}}}
|width        = {{dv|{{tt|500|Initial area width, estimated}}|{{tt|500|Zone from wall, estimated}}}}
|cast time    = none
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|1600|Initial missile speed}}|{{tt|1200|Speed of spreading around a wall}}}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = special
|callforhelp  = 
|notes        = 
* {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} recast does not incur the 1 second cooldown for regaining the stealth and instead prevents the stealth from being gained until the dash ends, resetting the cooldown if it is active.
** The cooldown is not reset if it was incurred by basic attacking a large monster, but is however reset from it being incurred by {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} channel.
* The bonus movement speed and camouflage are granted by the same buff, called [[File: Harrowed Path 2.png|20px|link=]] ''Lord of the Mist''.
* '''Viego''' will enter camouflage even while {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.
* '''Viego''' can cast ''Harrowed Path'' during the cast time of any ability or spell.
* ''Harrowed Path'' will follow '''Viego''' into {{cai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}}.
* Ranking up ''Harrowed Path'' while the effect is already active will still immediately improve the bonuses it grants.
* The initial missile can be destroyed by {{tip|projectile}}-blocking effects, but the formed Black Mist trail will not disappear. The wall spread missiles cannot be destroyed.
* ''Harrowed Path'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
** The spread path around terrain is determined upon collision and does not change even if the terrain expires mid-spread.
** {{Pending for test}} Terrain being created while ''Harrowed Path'' is spreading.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
** The stealth regain timer is refreshed from basic attacks at the start of their attack windup.
* '''Viego''' can benefit from an enemy's ''Harrowed Path'', gaining the bonus stats corresponding to his own ''Harrowed Path''.
|tips         =
* ''Harrowed Path'' will grant the {{tip|camouflage}} immediately if cast during {{ai|Spectral Maw|Viego}} or {{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}.
}}

|champion     = Viego
|skill        = R
|icon         = Heartbreaker.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Viego}} {{tip|blinks}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} based on his {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
|blurb2      = The most wounded enemy champion hit takes {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}, is dealt {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and is {{tip|slow|slowed}} briefly. Other enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The blink cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he strikes the {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} enemy champion {{tt|nearby|Alternatively the closest one if all targets have the same percent health}}, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. Other nearby enemies are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|12 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
|description2 = All targets hit are dealt {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}.
|description3 = ''If a {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}} is discarded, Heartbreaker will be placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.''

|cost         =

|target range = 500
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 300

|angle        = 
|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|speed        = 
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = special
|grounded     = true
|parry        = special
|projectile   = 
|callforhelp  = true
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* ''Heartbreaker'' will cast at the edge of its range if the target location is further beyond.
* ''Heartbreaker'' will cast at maximum range from the end of {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} dash if it is cast during the dash.
* The knockback speed is 1000 units per second. The airborne is removed as soon as the displacement ends.
** The maximum airborne duration is therefore {{fd|0.4}} seconds. The minimum is {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
* To the struck champion deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}; to all other enemies, deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* '''Viego''' will enter a {{fd|0.25}}-second [[cast time]] if he strikes an enemy champion.
** After this cast time, he will automatically receive an attack command against that enemy. Previous movement inputs from the player are ignored.{{bug|1}}
* ''Heartbreaker's'' strike to the champion can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but not {{tip|blind|missed}}.
* '''Viego''' will be ordered to [[basic attack]] the primary target afterwards.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Viego_Original_R_2.ogg}} ''"Isolde!"''
}}
